scope: surface Spearman before placement; local registry scan (EDTI function reused)

MPC-MAG.scope: Every pinned local registry dot-field raster present in this checkout (data/scored_fleet + docs/downloads + submission), listed row-by-row with SHA-256. Continuous full-support non-submission grids in the historical upstream inventory are handled by the PA-86-01 preflight certificate (literal reading reported, never hidden); under the literal support reading they block every nonempty candidate regardless of mechanism.
